ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1984
ISLAMIC UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Islamic University Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 5th June, 1984].
No. F. 17(1)/85-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Islamic University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 32, Ordinance LIM of 1980

ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1984
ORDINANCE XXVI OF 1984
ISLAMIC UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Islamic University Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 5th June, 1984].
No. F. 17(1)/85-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 32, Ordinance LIM of 1980.--In the Islamic
University Ordinance, 1980 (LIII of 1980), in section 32, after subsection (2),
the following new subsection shall be added, namely : -
"(3) No
order on an application for review shall be passed without affording to the
appellant or applicant, as the case may be, an opportunity of being
heard."
